# Medium-scale synthetic ERP data

> **All data here is SYNTHETIC** (fictional companies, people and amounts), generated by
> `generate_medium.py` with a fixed seed. About 118,000 source records across Odoo and ERPNext.

The JSON files are **not committed** (about 41 MB, git-ignored). Generate them with:

```powershell
python tests\fixtures\synthetic_medium\generate_medium.py
```

Same record shapes, batches (2026-09-30 full, 2026-10-31 incremental) and kinds of edge cases as
`tests/fixtures/synthetic/`; the helpers are imported from that generator. Odoo ids start at 1001 /
5001 / 10001 / 100001 / 500001 and ERPNext names are numbered to 5 digits, so nothing collides with the
small set or its verified cross-ERP mapping. Use and results: [docs/evaluation/SCALE_TEST.md](../../../docs/evaluation/SCALE_TEST.md).
